title: 信息如何逐步被压缩
goal: 验证 knowledge-explainer profile 能根据 explanatory verb 选择不同视觉语法，而不是退回统一卡片布局。
audience: 需要理解抽象机制的普通读者

hero.message: 从原始信息到核心结论，逐层保留最重要的内容
hero.visual_subject: 由宽到窄的多层信息堆栈

sections.heading: 筛选
content: 去除与目标无关的信息

sections.heading: 组织
content: 按因果、顺序或比较关系重组

sections.heading: 压缩
content: 保留关键结论与必要证据

sections.heading: 输出
content: 形成清晰、可阅读的解释

stages.label: 原始材料
stages.detail: 事实 + 背景 + 细节

visual.composition: stacked layers that visibly narrow toward the final explanation
visual.illustration_language: layered paper-like bands with direct labels

qa.three_second_read: viewer sees a layered accumulation/compression concept
qa.ten_second_path: viewer can read the five conceptual stages
qa.fact_check: synthetic explanatory mechanism contains no external factual claims
